A '''Wookiee individual''' was enslaved by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] enslaver [[Zarien Kheev]], who was allied with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the early [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] was being kept in Kheev's camp in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent [[Rianna Saren]] infiltrated the camp, searching for Kheev. The Wookiee advised her to deactivate the main security generator, which would allow her to reach Kheev in his main tower. In gratitude, Saren released the Wookiee and the other enslaved individuals.
